title: Clawback Prevention Across Consecutive Cycles
precondition: Month 1: Manager earns $800 fee; Month 2: Sub-account sustains $2,000 loss.
expected_result: Month 1 fees remain untouched (zero clawback); manager must recover to HWM before earning future fees.
actual_result: Historical performance fees are non-clawbackable; manager must recover subsequent losses to historical peak HWM before earning future shares.
